From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@acmeinc.com>, Liam Porter <liam.porter@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Jumpstart: Renewal origination, capacity uplift & technical handshake

Hi Erin / Liam —

Thanks for the time on the call earlier. As discussed, we want to kick off the Renewal / Uplift thread for Acme so we can lock a schedule for the QBR, scope the capacity uplift, and get the technical handshake with your infra team. High level asks below: 

- Confirm the target term change (12 -> 24 months) and desired uplift cadence (immediate + seasonal burst)
- Technical handshake to validate steady-state RPS and peak burst patterns (Connor will lead)
- Procurement / legal checkpoints and target signature window (looking at a June sign)
- QBR: propose week of May 24 — this will be our exec + ops readout.

Attached: draft QBR agenda and a capacity-forecast template — please fill the "expected peak" tab before the tech sync if you can.

Proposed next steps / meetings: 
1) Technical handshake (30 mins) — Connor + Liam + Acme infra — Thu May 6 or Mon May 10 (Connor: please confirm availability below)
2) Procurement check-in (15 mins) — with Procurement and David to review terms/training credits — Tue May 11
3) QBR (60 mins) — week of May 24 — tentative Wed May 26 10am PT (want exec presence from both sides)

Can you confirm the term preference, whether the May 26 QBR window works, and which of the tech-sync slots fits your schedule? If preferred, send a Calendly link and we’ll accept.

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
attach: redwood-qbr-agenda.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks — this looks great. Quick answers: 
- Term: we are leaning to 24 months but need one internal nod from finance (should be green by next week)
- Uplift: want an initial +20% steady-state uplift now, with scheduled seasonal bursts for Nov / Dec and next Mar
- QBR: May 26 works for Erin + Liam (please pencil it)

I'll have Procurement propose a PO timeline in a follow-up. Liam will coordinate on the technical data you requested and fill out the forecast tab by Friday.

—Erin
Erin Walsh
Director, Cloud Platform
Acme Inc.

Erin / Liam / Vanessa —

I can take the tech handshake. A few quick notes so we come prepared: 

1) Data we need before the sync (Liam, if you can drop these into the forecast sheet or share via Drive):
   - steady-state token/sec or RPS by route (chat, embeddings, batch infer)
   - 90th/95th percentile seq lengths and typical KV-cache hit rates
   - expected daily request schedule (local time) for peak weeks (Nov/Dec)

2) Proposed agenda for a 30-min tech sync:
   - 5m intros + success criteria
   - 10m workload profile review (you share numbers)
   - 10m mapping to Redwood capacity profiles and burst runway
   - 5m actions & owner assignment

3) Availability: Thu May 6 11:00-11:30 PT (already reserved), or Mon May 10 09:00-09:30 PT. If Thu is tight for you, I can also do Tue May 11 16:00 PT.

I’ll prepare an initial capacity mapping once we have the forecast inputs.

Connor Obrien
Technical Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(on behalf of Platform Eng)
